STEP 1 - Scene: A lunch tray with a sushi-and-wrap meal, a brownie, a coffee-style drink and two small sauce cups. Photographed from the front, roughly eye level with the tray, so depth is compressed somewhat. The tray has a card labelled 3083 and a colour calibration chart beside it, so it is a lab/study photo.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Main plate is a white paper plate about 23 cm in diameter (area ≈ 415 cm²). The brownie sits on a smaller side plate about 17 cm in diameter (area ≈ 227 cm²). The food on the main plate is the meal under estimation; the brownie is on its own plate but belongs to the same tray meal, so I include it.

STEP 3 - Items: (a) a tortilla wrap with shredded lettuce/cabbage and filling, (b) a second wrap (chicken/meat-style filling), (c) three small sushi rolls (sushi rice, nori, vegetables, imitation crab), (d) a brownie with nuts, (e) a latte/milky coffee in a white mug, (f) two small sauce cups, one dark (soy-like) and one pink (pickled ginger).

STEP 4 - Area (main plate, 415 cm²): wraps together ~25% (≈105 cm²), sushi rolls ~12% (≈50 cm²). Brownie on side plate: ~45% of that plate (≈100 cm²). Sauce cups are small (~1%).

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Wraps: 105 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 420 ml (tall, rolled pile) → loose-ish filling, treat as mixed dense wrap.
- Sushi: 3 rolls, each ~3 cm diameter × 2.5 cm long ≈ 18 ml each → 55 ml.
- Brownie: 100 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 300 ml, but a brownie is solid; use 3 cm × 4 cm × 4 cm block ≈ 48 ml... dimensions from image: roughly 5 × 5 × 3 cm ≈ 75 ml.
- Latte: mug ~ 250 ml, about 200 ml liquid.
- Sauce cups: ~5 ml each, 10 ml total.

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Wraps: 420 ml × 0.7 (dense, mixed filling) ≈ 290 g
- Sushi: 55 ml × 0.9 ≈ 50 g
- Brownie: 75 ml × 0.9 ≈ 65 g (dense)
- Latte: 200 ml × 1.0 ≈ 200 g
- Sauces: 10 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Wraps (tortilla with filling, ~220 kcal/100 g): 290 × 2.2 ≈ 640 kcal
- Sushi (~150 kcal/100 g): 50 × 1.5 ≈ 75 kcal
- Brownie (~420 kcal/100 g): 65 × 4.2 ≈ 275 kcal
- Latte (whole milk, ~60 kcal/100 g): 200 × 0.6 ≈ 120 kcal
- Sauces (~50 kcal/100 g): 10 × 0.5 ≈ 5 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 615 g and ≈ 1,115 kcal. This is plausible for a full lunch tray with two wrap pieces, sushi, a brownie and a milky coffee. The wrap estimate is the largest uncertainty.
